    "Explanation": [
      "Goal recap",
      "- The release flow required is a tag-triggered \"beta\" release: when a tag matching the beta product pattern is pushed, build → test → deploy must run. Non-beta tags must not trigger deploy. Branch builds should continue to run (build/test) and not be blocked.",
      "",
      "What the frozen artifacts show",
      "- Config defines a single workflow build-test-and-deploy with jobs build → test → deploy, and there are no filters configured.",
      "- The recorded run in workflow.txt is a branch run (branch: koans-09-tag-filters) where all three jobs ran and succeeded.",
      "",
      "Required scope and change",
      "- Scope to change: the workflow entry for the deploy job only (workflows: build-test-and-deploy: jobs: - deploy: ...). We must add a tag-only filter on the deploy job so that deploy runs only for beta tags.",
      "- Rationale: applying the tag filter only to deploy (instead of the whole workflow or to build/test) ensures that:",
      "  - Tag pushes that match the beta pattern will run build → test → deploy (deploy is explicitly allowed for those tags).",
      "  - Branch pushes continue to run build and test (deploy will be filtered out and not executed on branches).",
      "  - Non-beta tags will not trigger deploy (deploy will be filtered out), but build/test still participate in the tag flow because they have no restrictive filters.",
      "",
      "Exact filter to add (example)",
      "Add the following filters under the deploy job in the workflows section (adjust the regex if your beta naming differs; here we use tags that start with \"beta-\"):",
      "",
      "workflows:",
      "  build-test-and-deploy:",
      "    jobs:",
      "      - build",
      "      - test:",
      "          requires:",
      "            - build",
      "      - deploy:",
      "          requires:",
      "            - test",
      "          filters:",
      "            tags:",
      "              only:",
      "                - /^beta-.*$/",
      "",
      "Behavior after the change",
      "- Tag matching /^beta-.*$/: pipeline will run build, test, then deploy — satisfying the beta-tagged release flow.",
      "- Non-beta tag: build and test will run, deploy will be skipped (filtered out) — deploy will not run for non-beta tags.",
      "- Branch run: build and test continue to run; deploy will be skipped because it only runs for beta tags. The workflow remains green in each case (filtered-out jobs are simply omitted; CircleCI runs the jobs that match filters and their dependencies).",
